tool_schemas.name: octagon-sec-agent
tool_schemas.description: Runs the Octagon security intelligence agent for the given workspace, creating a new session (using session_title/session_context) or attaching the run to an existing session_id, and returns the created agent run plus any stored output artifacts produced by the run. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id/session_id do not match the required ULID formats, required fields are missing, additionalProperties are provided, or the input payload is not an object; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace_id does not exist or if session_id is provided but does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the workspace/session, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when your workspace or API key has exhausted its allowed run capacity.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (oct_ws_...) that will own the session/run/artifacts.

session_id.description: Existing session ULID (oct_sess_...) to attach this agent run to.

session_title.description: Title to use when creating a new session (ignored if session_id is provided).

session_context.description: Optional structured context to store on the session for later auditing/reuse.

input.description: Agent input payload for the security agent (prompt, targets, constraints, etc.).

Raises FORBIDDEN when you lack access to the workspace/session, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when run or data-access limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: octagon-investors-agent
tool_schemas.description: [PRIVATE MARKET INTELLIGENCE] A specialized database agent for looking up information on investors. Capabilities: Retrieve information about investors, their investment criteria, and past activities. Best for: Research on investors and details about their investment activities. NOTE: For better and more accurate results, provide the investor's website URL instead of just the investor name. Example queries: 'What is the latest investment criteria of Insight Partners (insightpartners.com)?', 'How many investments did Andreessen Horowitz (a16z.com) make in the last 6 months', 'What is the typical check size for QED Investors (qedinvestors.com)'.

input.description: Agent input payload for investor lookup (criteria, portfolio, activity) and related queries.

tool_schemas.name: octagon-scraper-agent
tool_schemas.description: [PUBLIC & PRIVATE MARKET INTELLIGENCE] Specialized agent for financial data extraction from investor websites. Capabilities: Extract structured financial data from investor relations websites, tables, and online financial sources. Best for: Gathering financial data from websites that don't have accessible APIs. Example queries: 'Extract all data fields from zillow.com/san-francisco-ca/', 'Extract all data fields from www.carvana.com/cars/'.

session_id.description: Session ULID to attach this agent run and resulting artifacts to.

title.description: Optional human-readable title for the session (used if a new session is created implicitly).

context.description: Optional session context object to store alongside the conversation for later auditing/reuse.

url.description: Primary URL to scrape and extract data from.

urls.description: Optional list of URLs to scrape in a single run.

query.description: Natural-language instruction describing what to extract from the page(s).

extract_schema.description: Optional JSON schema-like object describing the desired structured output fields.

selectors.description: Optional CSS/XPath selector hints to target specific page regions or tables.

max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl/follow for this run.

follow_links.description: Whether the scraper may follow links from the provided URL(s) to gather additional data.

include_tables.description: Whether to specifically extract HTML tables into structured form.

include_text.description: Whether to include extracted plain text snippets in the output.

source_urls.description: Optional additional source URLs to attribute in resulting artifacts.

input.description: Tool-specific input payload stored on the agent run.

tool_schemas.name: octagon-deep-research-agent
tool_schemas.description: [PUBLIC & PRIVATE MARKET INTELLIGENCE] A comprehensive agent that can utilize multiple sources for deep research analysis. Capabilities: Aggregate research across multiple data sources, synthesize information, and provide comprehensive investment research. Best for: Investment research questions requiring up-to-date aggregated information from the web. Example queries: 'Research the financial impact of Apple's privacy changes on digital advertising companies' revenue and margins', 'Analyze the competitive landscape in the cloud computing sector, focusing on AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud margin and growth trends', 'Investigate the factors driving electric vehicle adoption and their impact on battery supplier financials'.

session_id.description: Session ULID to attach this agent run and resulting artifacts to.

title.description: Optional human-readable title for the session (used if a new session is created implicitly).

context.description: Optional session context object to store alongside the conversation for later auditing/reuse.

query.description: Research question or task description to investigate and synthesize.

market_scope.description: Which market scope to emphasize for the research run.

sources.description: Optional list of source types or domains to prioritize during research.

entities.description: Optional list of companies/people/tickers/entities to focus on.

from.description: Start of the time window to consider when gathering information.

to.description: End of the time window to consider when gathering information.

time_range.description: Optional time window constraints for the research.

output_format.description: Preferred primary artifact output format for the run.

include_citations.description: Whether to include a citations artifact with source URLs.

include_financial_tables.description: Whether to try to produce structured financial tables as artifacts when available.

input.description: Tool-specific input payload stored on the agent run.

tool_schemas.name: octagon-debts-agent
tool_schemas.description: Runs the Private Market Intelligence debts agent for the given query, attaching the run to an existing session_id (or implicitly creating a new session using title/context) and returning the created agent run plus any resulting research artifacts (e.g., private debt activity extracts, facility/deal details, citations) recorded for audit. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if session_id is present but does not match the required ULID pattern, if required fields like input.query are missing, if date-time fields are not valid RFC 3339 timestamps, or if input includes unsupported properties. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to invoke the private-debts agent or access the referenced session, NOT_FOUND if the provided session_id does not exist or is not accessible to the caller, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED/RATE_LIMITED when agent-run execution or storage limits are exceeded.

session_id.description: Session ULID to attach this agent run and resulting artifacts to.

title.description: Optional human-readable title for the session (used if a new session is created implicitly).

context.description: Optional session context object to store alongside the conversation for later auditing/reuse.

query.description: Natural-language debt research query (e.g., borrower/lender and time period constraints).

borrower.description: Optional borrower name to filter the private debt activity lookup.

lender.description: Optional lender name to filter the private debt activity lookup.

as_of.description: Optional point-in-time date to anchor the results (if supported by the underlying dataset).

from.description: Start of the time window to consider for debt activities.

to.description: End of the time window to consider for debt activities.

time_range.description: Optional time window constraints for the debt activities.

include_debt_facilities.description: Whether to attempt to return/produce debt facility details as artifacts.

include_deals.description: Whether to attempt to return/produce related deals as artifacts.

input.description: Tool-specific input payload stored on the agent run.

tool_schemas.name: octagon-list-sessions
tool_schemas.description: Lists sessions in a workspace, with filtering and cursor pagination. Returns only sessions visible to the calling API key; refuses if the workspace is deleted (not found) or the API key is invalid.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (oct_ws_...) that owns the sessions.

q.description: Optional free-text filter applied to title (and may match other indexed metadata).

created_after.description: Return sessions created strictly after this timestamp (RFC3339).

created_before.description: Return sessions created strictly before this timestamp (RFC3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: octagon-get-session
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single session by id and returns its stored fields. Refuses if the session does not exist, belongs to a deleted workspace, or is not accessible to the calling API key.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (oct_ws_...) that owns the session.

include_context.description: Whether to include the session context object in the response.

tool_schemas.name: octagon-update-session
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on a session (title/context) and/or performs allowed lifecycle transitions (open↔archived, open/archived→deleted). Refuses invalid transitions, attempts to update a deleted session, or access to a deleted workspace (not found).

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (oct_ws_...) that owns the session.

title.description: New human-readable title for the session.

context.description: New structured context to store on the session (replaces the previous context).

status.description: Lifecycle transition for the session status. Must follow allowed transitions.

tool_schemas.name: octagon-list-agent-runs
tool_schemas.description: Lists agent runs in a workspace (optionally scoped to a session) with filtering and cursor pagination. Returns run records and usage metadata; refuses if the workspace is deleted (not found) or the API key is invalid.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (oct_ws_...) that owns the runs.

session_id.description: If provided, only return runs belonging to this session.

tool_name.description: If provided, only return runs executed by this agent tool surface name (must match agent_tools.tool_name).

created_after.description: Return runs created strictly after this timestamp (RFC3339).

created_before.description: Return runs created strictly before this timestamp (RFC3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of runs to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

include_input.description: Whether to include the stored input payload in each run (may be redacted if secrets are detected).

tool_schemas.name: octagon-cancel-agent-run
tool_schemas.description: Cancels an agent run that is in queued or running state by transitioning it to cancelled. Returns the updated run record; refuses if the run is already terminal (succeeded/failed/cancelled) or does not belong to the provided workspace/session.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (oct_ws_...) that owns the run.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for cancellation (stored for audit).
